description: Altitude-D adjudicable If spines: D1 Violence DR12, D2 Crit/fumble/rest/infection, D3 creature attack/defence DR overrides via Circumstance-[:APPLIES_TO]->creature instance (opaque If.id — no creature name in id). D3 overrides SUPERSEDES matching D1 defaults (Briefing 22). Slice 2c Morale procedure FOR MoraleCheck (Briefing 25); Compare COMPARED_TO sheet Morale. Slice 2d More HP FOR Advancement COMPARED_TO HitPoints; Ability changes FOR Advancement COMPARED_TO AbilityScore (low-band SUPERSEDES default). Slice 2e Powers FOR Power: daily uses formula (no Compare) + scroll Presence DR12. Slice 2f K1 Create a Player Character FOR CharacterCreation (numbered list THEN; optional class stays off this If). Slice 3b Omens FOR Omen (start d2 without classes / regain when depleted / five spends as THEN). Slice 3u Outcasts (followers) FOR Outcast (no silver / morale check + highest Presence / consider values as THEN). Coverage 1 Tests FOR Test (d20 ± ability ≥ DR); Carrying FOR Carrying (Strength+8 / +2 DR / twice cap); Broken FOR Broken (Toughness+d8 / 0 HP / negative dead); Abilities FOR Abilities (uses-list + 3d6 generation); Calendar FOR Calendar (dawn Misery / d66 / 7:7). Slice 2g Repair FOR Repair (cannot-higher-than-original footnote; prices stay RepairArmorTable). Closed vocabulary only.

creature_dr_overrides.notes: Batch CREATURES entity passages. First matching extract_rule wins. Skip ability-test / infection / paralysis DR lines.

then.name: double-damage
then.summary: Crit on attack: double damage.

then.name: armor-tier-down
then.summary: Crit on attack: armor/protection reduced one tier.

spines.notes: One If with two FOR (MeleeAttack + RangedAttack). Bare Bones defence crit is different (PC gains a free attack) — not this spine; see handoff.

then.name: double-damage
then.summary: Fumbled defence: PC takes double damage.

then.name: armor-tier-down
then.summary: Fumbled defence: armor reduced one tier.

spines.notes: Defence fumble (natural 1). Attack fumble (weapon breaks/lost) deferred.

then.name: restore-d4-hp
then.summary: Catch breath and drink: restore d4 HP.

spines.notes: FOR Downtime (no Rest SeedNode). Circumstance situating atom.

then.name: no-rest-benefit
then.summary: Infected: no HP restored from resting; instead lose d6 HP daily.

spines.notes: AND of Circumstance Infected + resting (not status Condition). Book: infected does not benefit from resting; d6 HP lost daily.

atoms.name: a single enemy has only 1/3 of its HP left

then.name: roll-2d6-vs-morale
then.summary: Roll for morale: 2d6 against the creature's Morale value.

spines.notes: Slice 2c / Briefing 25: roll-morale triggers (OR). FOR MoraleCheck (procedure); sheet SeedNode:Morale stays HAS_MORALE / COMPARED_TO only.

then.name: demoralized
then.summary: 2d6 greater than Morale: creature is demoralized.

else.name: morale-holds
else.summary: 2d6 not greater than Morale: creature continues.

spines.notes: FOR MoraleCheck. Compare 2d6 > creature Morale (COMPARED_TO SeedNode:Morale; threshold from sheet HAS_MORALE at runtime).

then.name: flees
then.summary: Demoralized: d6 1–3 → enemy flees.

spines.notes: FOR MoraleCheck. Bare Bones: Roll d6 — (1–3) flees or (4–6) surrenders. AND demoralized + d6<=3 → flee; ELSE surrender.

then.name: increase-max-hp-d6
then.summary: 6d10 equal to or greater than current maximum HP: increase maximum HP by d6.

else.name: no-hp-gain
else.summary: 6d10 below current maximum HP: maximum HP does not increase.

spines.notes: Slice 2d / Getting Better More HP. FOR Advancement (procedure); sheet SeedNode:HitPoints stays HAS_HIT_POINTS / COMPARED_TO only. Threshold is the PC's current max from the situation, not a seed constant.

then.name: increase-ability-1
then.summary: d6 equal to or greater than the ability: increase it by 1, to a maximum of +6.

else.name: decrease-ability-1
else.summary: d6 below the ability: decrease it by 1.

text_contains_any: Roll a d6 against every ability

spines.notes: Slice 2d / Getting Better Ability changes default. FOR Advancement; COMPARED_TO AbilityScore (situation value, not a seed threshold). Cap +6 is the THEN outcome, not a Compare threshold.

then.name: decrease-ability-1-floor-minus-3
then.summary: Abilities from −3 to +1 and d6 is 1: reduce by 1, never below −3.

spines.notes: Slice 2d / Getting Better Ability changes override. Band + nat 1 SUPERSEDES the default d6>=ability increase (which would otherwise always succeed in this band). No ELSE — when the AND is false, the default If applies.

then.name: daily-uses-presence-plus-d4
then.summary: Daily Power uses = Presence + d4 (roll each morning; choose from available scrolls).

spines.notes: Slice 2e W1. Formula lives on the Outcome — not a Compare (Compare is yes/no). FOR Power; procedure APPLIES_TO Presence. Do not encode 1+3=4 in Python.

then.name: activate-and-spend-use
then.summary: Scroll Power activates; subtract one use from the daily total.

else.name: fail-d2-dizzy
else.summary: Power doesn't work; lose d2 HP; dizzy for the next hour; Powers fail in the worst possible way.

spines.notes: Slice 2e W2. Ordinary Presence DR12 Compare on FOR Power. Cite preamble only — not Unclean/Sacred catalogue rows. Nested Foul d6 is OQ-ADAPT-07.

then.name: randomize-starting-equipment
then.summary: Randomize your starting equipment on this page and the next.

then.name: randomize-weapon-and-armor
then.summary: Randomize weapon and armor.

then.name: roll-abilities
then.summary: Roll your abilities.

then.name: roll-hit-points
then.summary: Roll your Hit Points.

then.name: name-if-you-wish
then.summary: Name your character if you wish. It will not save you.

then.name: starting-silver-waterskin-food
then.summary: 2d6 × 10 silver (s); a waterskin and d4 days worth of food.

spines.notes: Slice 2f K1. Numbered Bare Bones list as THEN Outcomes (book wording). Optional class / pp.38–42 / Omens stay off this If — they are Optional rules in the same passage (citation only). No Compare. No ELSE.

then.name: begin-d2-without-classes
then.summary: Every class gains a number of Omens. If you play without classes every character begins with d2 Omens.

then.name: regain-after-six-hours
then.summary: When depleted roll the class's designated die (d2 if playing without classes) and regain that many Omens after resting at least six hours.

then.name: deal-maximum-damage
then.summary: Use an Omen to deal maximum damage with an attack.

then.name: reroll-a-dice-roll
then.summary: Use an Omen to reroll a dice roll (yours or someone else's).

then.name: lower-damage-d6
then.summary: Use an Omen to lower damage dealt to you by d6.

then.name: neutralize-crit-or-fumble
then.summary: Use an Omen to neutralize a Crit or Fumble.

then.name: lower-one-test-dr-by-4
then.summary: Use an Omen to lower one test's DR by -4.

spines.notes: Slice 3b N1–N3. Optional luck pool as THEN (book wording). No Compare. No ELSE. Class-specific omen dice stay in optional-class prose. Not Rest (D2). Not Power. Not Arcane Catastrophes.

then.name: do-not-cost-silver-to-hire
then.summary: Money might cross hands but these weirdos don't cost silver to hire.

then.name: morale-check-plus-highest-presence
then.summary: The GM makes a morale check from time to time (succeed and the outcast stays) and adds the group's highest Presence to the roll.

then.name: consider-whether-group-provides-values
then.summary: The GM should also consider whether or not the group provides the outcast with the things he/she/it values.

spines.notes: Slice 3u OC1–OC3. Hire/stay how-to as THEN (book wording). No Compare. No ELSE. Not 2c MoraleCheck. Not SupportingCharacter. Not 3q–3t generator tables.

then.name: d20-plus-ability-vs-dr
then.summary: Tests are made against a Difficulty Rating. To succeed roll d20 ±your ability with a result equal to or greater than the DR.

then.name: creatures-roll-d20-against-dr
then.summary: Creatures don't use abilities, they just roll a d20 against DR.

spines.notes: Coverage 1 TS1. How-to as THEN (book wording). No Compare. No ELSE. Not FOR AbilityTest. Not melee/ranged/defence. DRTable is unique-row DT1, not packed here.

then.name: strength-plus-8-normal-items
then.summary: You can carry Strength+8 normal-sized items (for example crowbars, lard, scrolls, torches but not anvils, chests, ladders, corpses) without a problem.

then.name: overload-raises-dr-by-2
then.summary: After that when testing Strength and Agility DR increases by 2 (from 12 to 14 etc.). It is impossible to carry more than twice Strength+8.

spines.notes: Coverage 1 CA1. How-to as THEN (book wording). No Compare. No ELSE. Not FOR AbilityTest. Not a table.

then.name: begin-toughness-plus-d8
then.summary: Begin with Toughness + d8. In worst case 1HP, but never less.

then.name: zero-broken-negative-dead
then.summary: Zero HP: broken Negative HP: dead

spines.notes: Coverage 1 HP1. How-to as THEN (book wording). No Compare. No ELSE. Not FOR HitPoints sheet. BrokenTable d4 is unique-row BK1. Not 3c Broken bodies. Not D2 rest.

then.name: agility-uses
then.summary: AGILITY: Defend, balance, swim, flee.

then.name: presence-uses
then.summary: PRESENCE: Perceive, aim, charm, wield Powers.

then.name: strength-uses
then.summary: STRENGTH: Crush, lift, strike, grapple.

then.name: toughness-uses
then.summary: TOUGHNESS: Resist poison/cold/heat, survive falling.

then.name: roll-3d6-use-table
then.summary: Roll 3d6 and using the table on the right to generate each ability score from −3 to +3. The sum is not used in the game once the character is created, only the table value.

then.name: optional-4d6-drop-lowest-two
then.summary: Player Characters not created with the optional classes can roll 4d6 and drop the lowest die for two of their abilities. When the character is later improved an ability can never exceed +6 or −3.

spines.notes: Coverage 1 AB1–AB2. Uses-list + generation how-to as THEN (book wording). No Compare. No ELSE. Not FOR Agility (would pack on C3). AbilitiesTable unique-row AB3. Not Tests.

then.name: dawn-die-activates-misery
then.summary: The Game Master (GM) rolls a die each dawn. A result of 1 activates one Misery. The die used is determined by the GM and the group.

then.name: d66-which-misery
then.summary: The GM then rolls d66 to determine which Misery occurs. The same Misery will not befall the world twice.

then.name: seventh-is-7-7
then.summary: The seventh Misery will always be 7:7, and the world finally dies. The seventh seal is broken for the seventh and final time. The game and your lives end here. Burn the book.

spines.notes: Coverage 2 leftover CAL1–CAL2. Dawn how-to as THEN (book wording). No Compare. No ELSE. Not FOR Misery. Do not pack d66 psalm rows or AgonyEndTable durations. AgonyEndTable unique-row T2.

then.name: cannot-higher-than-original
then.summary: Armor cannot be repaired to a tier higher than its original.

spines.notes: 2g B7. How-to as THEN (book footnote). No Compare. No ELSE. Not FOR Armor. Do not pack the two price rows. RepairArmorTable unique-row B5/B6.
